what: Mukund's YOLO11s fire detector: scores on its validation split after the last of 100 training epochs
source: FIRE-LOCALIZATION-AND-VOLUME-ESTIMATION repo (Mukund MV), train/results.csv and train/args.yaml (model yolo11s.pt, imgsz 640, 100 epochs, seed 0)
split: the validation split of the team's fire-image dataset (YOLO 'val'); the images and the split are in the CV repo, not here
limits: Trained and scored on Earth flame photos; not tested on microgravity flames, for which no labelled footage exists yet.
Scores are from the validation split used during training, not a separate held-out test set.
